timed_scope: existing runner input/source hashes and input loading, fresh child startup/import, all branch completion and collection, transfer/selection and final double validation
management_preflight: before each timed executor call, pilot wrapper also hashes registered sources, all three frozen input inventories and dependency module files uniformly for all methods
management_preflight_timing: outside the original timed executor; its per-trial cost is in inter-wrapper gaps except first preflight/setup, and no existing timed input hash/load was removed
cache_scope: no deliberate warm-up, cache clear/prefetch or method-specific operation. Integrity reads can populate OS caches; cold cache is not claimed and historical timing conditions are not asserted identical. All 75 new attempts use the same registered wrapper; no historical timing rows are pooled.
initial_management_preflight_reason: not separately timestamped before coordinator metadata; do not invent zero or treat import-only setup as full preparation
final_post_wrapper_output_reason: last metadata and invocation-result output are not separately clocked; costs are not complete end-to-end upper bounds
cost_prediction_scope: measured T_attempt means plus separately modeled observed gap/wrapper overhead; registration, measured import setup, analysis and final audit/output have their own scope. Missing fixed preparation/output stays unknown. No finite wall upper bound.
parent_HWM_scope: RUSAGE_SELF lifetime highwater of the reused coordinator sampled at trial end; not a per-trial instantaneous peak
branch_HWM_scope: fresh child RUSAGE_SELF lifetime highwater, KiB; summing highwaters is nonconcurrent and duplicates shared pages
resource_sample_scope: RSS summed over observed child process trees; nominal 0.5 second monitoring, actual measurement/record delays retained, instantaneous peaks not guaranteed observed
first_arrival_reason: not exported/observed by inherited timed executor; completion T is never substituted
git_scope: source-scoped status completed clean before experiment; full status/diff not completed, see PREFLIGHT_STATUS.json
preservation_scope: 839 protected-file hashes; historical per-evaluation traces not individually rehashed, old namespaces never written by this task
